verdicts.reasoning: I tried to reduce this to first-contact unfamiliarity and could not, because every fact the joiner lacks at the $50 decision point already exists in the database and is deliberately not delivered to the screen where the decision is made. The unfamiliarity defense ("a real invitee has Casey on the group text; all four personas joined anyway in ~4 minutes and understood the game within ten") is true but lands AFTER the commitment: the post-join THREE THINGS sheet and How-scoring-works do the teaching, so the model clears up in minutes only once the person has already said "I'm in for $50". An interface that explains the offer only after acceptance is failing at the moment the explanation is needed, which is the lens's test. Three components are hard-confirmed in code and live: (1) the consent sheet's content is capped by the anon RPC `join_covenant_info`, which returns only name/buyin/preset/floor/finish/structure; the roster count, the Pro's name, `seasons.starts_on/ends_on` and the point bands are one join away and not selected; the sheet does not even link to the existing `openScoringHelp()` that the post-join welcome links to. (2) The invite landing and manual-code copy ("Enter your email and you're in" / "you'll join X the moment your sign-in code lands") promise instant membership, and the actual path is email -> code -> golfer card -> orientation -> a $50 consent sheet; the copy contradicts the flow it introduces. (3) "Not now" genuinely loses the invite: `cs_code`/`cs_code_name` are removed from localStorage before `covenantGate` runs, so declining leaves only a transient toast and a league-less Home with no card and an empty Join sheet. Two components are weaker and I would down-weight them: the cold door being a slogan is an owner decision (D83: "the door sells with its own splash"; D82 puts depth at the doors post-auth), and many consumer apps have a brand door -- though the product already wrote the one-breath definition ("Season-long golf with the people you already play with -- points, pot, pressure") and only ships it in the meta description, and the desktop "wings" that were supposed to show real-looking season objects are display:none below 1100px, so the phone door has no explanatory layer at all. The `__CS_VERSION__` placeholder cited by the skeptic is a local unstamped build artifact (Netlify stamps it) and should be struck from the evidence. The iOS rank card ("2nd · — held · 10 points back of the lead · Partial month · floors waived") is confirmed to have no tap route to any explanation; scoring help lives only in You > How it works, the post-round screen and the bylaws card. Not "Intentional complexity": the covenant was scoped to S3-01 ("money never surprises anybody") and the door's explanation was removed with the demo, not by a decision to withhold the offer; nothing in the decision log says a joiner should decide on four bylaw rows.

verdicts.reasoning:
I tried to disprove this as first-time-user unfamiliarity and could not: the headline defect is a client ReferenceError that fires AFTER the server has committed four writes, and no familiarity with the product changes what the user sees. The lock button's only feedback is a 2.4-second toast reading "Lock failed. Something went wrong — please try again." (humanError's generic branch), the success sheet (openLockShare) is unreachable because it sits after the throwing call inside the same try block, and prod telemetry shows every lock attempt since D97 shipped has failed at the client — no league has locked successfully since 2026-07-27. Two independent testers reproduced it 11 times. That is an interface failing at exactly the moment it is needed, not a learning curve.

Where the finding overreaches, I trimmed it rather than refuted it: (1) "the product's only invite moment" is wrong — the room's Standings hero, the Members & invites sheet (header shows CODE XXXX), the Add-golfers footer and the Home hero all carry "Share the invite link"; openLockShare is only the ONLY surface that prints the join URL as visible text. (2) "a code in a vanishing toast" is partly a harness artifact: shareInvite() calls navigator.share first (a real phone gets the OS share sheet with the URL) and then clipboard.writeText (https desktop gets "Invite link copied"); the bare "Invite code: X" toast is the double-fallback the headless browser hit, and the tester acknowledged this. Still, no surface except the never-opening sheet shows the link as text with a copy affordance. (3) "no way to invite friends who lack accounts" is true for email/SMS (no email UI exists — #emailSlots is absent from the markup, state.emails is always [''], the invites table has no sender, and Cup-Season-Guide.md:107 wrongly claims "invite by email") but the join link does reach account-less friends: signed-out /?join=THEPTCQ5 renders "You're invited to The Papago Grind. Enter your email and you're in." Link-first inviting is D97's deliberate design, so this sub-claim is a doc/copy mismatch, not a blocking gap. (4) The $75 buy-in is not "hidden from the lock decision": the step-3 review table shows BUY-IN above the lock button (org/30 shows $50; nov's review shows $25 — both testers found and changed it), and the joiner's covenant discloses it with a "Join — I'm in for $N" button (verified live via the anon join_covenant_info RPC: buyin_cents 5000). But $75 IS the effective default a Pro sees despite resetWizard() setting state.stake=0: #stakeVal is static "$75" markup that nothing re-renders on the create path, and league_settings.buyin_cents defaults to 7500 in the DB so any reload mid-wizard (boot → enterLeague → applyBylaws) loads $75 back into state. That contradicts setup-QA S2-03 and D46. (5) The "seven pilot Pros stalled here" line is misattributed: the index.html:10080 comment is D96's measurement from 2026-08-04 about the forming hero having no CTA; the staged bug was introduced by D97 (1fd47e1) the same evening, after that measurement, and all-time telemetry shows only 12 lock attempts from 3 people. The pilot stall predates this bug.

Net: the core claim — the organizer cannot finish, the app reports failure after committing, retries mutate the league further (the novice's Solo retry re-wrote settings/phase while the first attempt's squads stayed formed), and the share moment never opens — is a confirmed, reproducible interface defect on the single most consequential tap in the product.

Secondary causes: the `$75` in #stakeVal is static markup never re-rendered after resetWizard() sets stake to 0, and league_settings.buyin_cents defaults to 7500 in the DB so a reload reloads $75; there is no email-invite UI despite Cup-Season-Guide.md claiming one; shareInvite()'s double fallback (no navigator.share, no clipboard) shows a bare code.

Level: IA + onboarding sequencing (with a data-layer sub-cause and a copy sub-cause). It is NOT a hard-to-explain mechanic — the app already has a two-sentence explanation (GUIDE.games, index.html:13223; openLeagueWelcome, ~15390) and a bands table (openScoringHelp, 17274); they simply all sit AFTER the commit.

Three decisions compound:

1. The invite was built as PLUMBING, not as an artifact. `/?join=CODE` "rides the existing cs_code auto-join machinery" (comment at index.html:17813): the link is consumed into localStorage, the URL is rewritten to `/`, and the only thing resolved pre-auth is the league NAME (`league_by_code` returns `text`, migration 20260714040000:14–17). The share text Casey sends is literally `You're invited to ${name} on Cup Season: url` (shareInvite, 14118). So the product's only acquisition channel (canon: shareable artifacts, foursome-by-foursome, no paid acquisition — decision-log:722) carries no pitch, no stake, no dates, no people. By contrast the D57 season share page IS an artifact and already returns dates/standings to anon — the invite never got the same treatment.

2. The door is auth-only by design (D83 retired the demo: "the door sells with its own splash", index.html:2650). The sell was delegated to the invite; the invite delegates it to the friend. Nobody holds it. The door's `#obStatus` line ("Enter your email and you're in", 17832/17914) then contradicts the real flow (OTP → golfer card → D82 orientation → $50 covenant).

3. S3-01's covenant was framed as a money DISCLOSURE, not a DECISION surface. `covenantGate()` (15422–15440) renders exactly what `join_covenant_info` returns, and that RPC (20260722211500:29–42) reads only `leagues` + `league_settings`: name, buyin_cents, preset, floor, finish, structure. No `seasons` row (starts_on/ends_on), no `league_members` (count, names, the Pro), no pot split, no counting cap, no bands. The iOS `CovenantSheet` (JoinLeagueFlow.swift:131–138) mirrors it field-for-field, so both clients are starved by the same RPC. "PRESET Standard" is shown because it is in the payload, not because anyone decided a joiner needs it.

Sequencing makes it worse: `resumeAfterProfile` (17552–17568) computes `viaInvite` with the explicit intent "an invited member is taught by their league covenant, never generic first-run copy" — yet the D82 orientation (cs_oriented, 13191–13206) fires first, and the covenant it hands off to has nothing to teach with. The covenant also removes `cs_code` BEFORE it runs (17564, a loop guard), so "Not now" is indistinguishable from a failed join: the invite evaporates, the Home tile reads "LEAGUE · None yet" (9874), and the only trace is a toast (17572). Inconsistency found while tracing: boot()'s signed-in path (17506–17512) calls `join_league` with NO covenantGate at all — a returning user who taps a /?join= link is put on the pot sheet with zero disclosure, a direct S3-01 violation.

On the phone: HomeView.swift `line` (~591–600) is a status sentence ("N points back of the lead.") with no affordance; the iOS app ships no guide/how-it-works surface at all (survey: 11 screens, no definition of a point), so the rank card has nowhere to point.

Tradeoffs / principles to respect: (1) Privacy — the code becomes a read credential for roster names; it already IS the join credential and already leaks the name to anon, and the D57 law (fail-closed token, revocable, curated payload) applies — extend it via SECURITY DEFINER RPC only, never anon table grants (CLAUDE.md D37 rule); log it as a decision-log entry (IA level, extends S3-01 + D57) before building. (5) Deploy skew — client renders each row only when the field is present (the template already does `info.preset?…`); RPC defaults every new key. (6) D82's "copy is a second place the model is described and must be kept true" — the card's sentence must be sourced from the same GUIDE string, not a third paraphrase.
verdicts.reasoning: Four of six web personas (joiner, skeptic, competitive, casual) and the iOS survey independently hit the same wall, and the code confirms why: the data needed to decide is not available at any pre-commit surface. The door HTML (2635–2660) has no explanatory copy; the pre-auth path resolves only a league name (`league_by_code` → text); the covenant renders the five-field `join_covenant_info` payload verbatim (15428–15438) and that RPC never joins `seasons` or `league_members`; iOS mirrors it. The rich explanations the personas eventually found (welcome sheet "THREE THINGS TO KNOW", GUIDE.games, openScoringHelp, the bylaws disclosure) are all gated behind join_league or buried in You › How it works. The "Not now" loss is a code-level consequence of removing cs_code before covenantGate (17564). The additional finding that boot()'s signed-in path (17506) skips the covenant entirely shows the consent was bolted onto two of three join paths rather than designed as the decision moment. This is a genuine, reproducible problem at the IA/sequencing level, not user education (there is nothing to read), not intentional complexity (S3-01's stated intent is "money never surprises anybody", and the resumeAfterProfile comment says the covenant is meant to be the invitee's teaching), and not a mechanic that resists explanation (the app's own two-sentence guide does it).

Commit 1fd47e1 (D97) removed the `staged` array from `lockBylaws()` but left `invited: staged.length` in the return at index.html:15218, so every lock throws a ReferenceError AFTER the settings/season/form_squads/phase writes have committed; the handler's catch reports failure, and the success path that opens the share sheet is unreachable. Something went wrong') via humanError's generic branch, and never runs loadMemberships(), switchView('home') or openLockShare() — which is the ONLY call site of the share sheet in the file (grep confirms one caller). That is why "the screen did not change" and "the post-lock share sheet never opens". cupseason.app is stamped `v23 · 34d20b6` (current main HEAD) and serves the same line, so it has been live for 25 days. Prod telemetry (client_events, read-only query): lock_ok = 1 (2026-07-27, pre-D97); lock_fail = 11, all 2026-08-29, all `staged is not defined`; invite_open = 1 (07-27). (2) MECHANICS — "lock" is not a server-side thing. There is no lock_league RPC; the lock is four direct client writes (the 2026-08-28 CLAUDE.md note lists lock-league among the dropped-{error} writes). Retapping is non-idempotent in the dangerous direction: RLS `settings_write` (baseline:2313) is `USING (is_commissioner AND locked_at IS NULL)`, so every retap's bylaws update silently matches zero rows (supabase-js returns no error), while `leagues_update` (baseline:2156) has no lock guard and the client derives nextPhase from LOCAL state.structure. The novice's Solo retry therefore wrote phase='season' against bylaws still locked at squads2. Prod now holds Desert Dogs: structure=squads2, phase=season, 2 squads with 0 players, 1 member — a state spec §15 forbids ("Season can't start with unassigned members") — which is why Home says SEASON LIVE while the Clubhouse says SQUADS LOCKED / Before first tee. Compounding: the Home forming hero (10094-10113) only distinguishes phase==='season', so a LOCKED-but-alone league (phase 'draft') still reads "Just you so far. Lock the bylaws and the invite link is yours" with CTA "Lock it in and invite your crew" — org shot 35 shows this after the commit, and it will persist after the one-line fix. The review footer "Lock opens the invite link" is also false: the code and join_league work in setup phase (switcherChip literally says "Setup — invites open").

(4) MONEY — a three-level conflict, and the finding is right for a different path than it named. Spec §7 says "default $75" and the schema encodes it (`buyin_cents integer DEFAULT 7500 NOT NULL`, baseline:1082; create_league inserts `league_settings (league_id)` with defaults, baseline:237). D46 later ruled "$0 bragging rights is first-class and the default … surfaced so it's seen, not buried". A-W3 then put every dial behind one Customize disclosure. S2-03's fix set state.stake=0 in resetWizard() ONLY: the `#stakeVal` label keeps the hardcoded `$75` (markup 3263; renderSetup() runs in the boot chain at 12974 and on the stepper, never on create) — the novice's "one tap of − from $75 goes straight to None" is the tell that state was 0 while the label said 75; any Pro who leaves and comes back (the D96 case) gets applyBylaws() (14351) loading 7500 into state and the lock commits it; and pre-lock, join_covenant_info reads `coalesce(ls.buyin_cents,0)` with no locked_at guard while join_league has no phase guard, so a friend joining any of the seven stalled prod leagues today (all carry 7500) is asked to be "in for $75" for a stake nobody chose. The demo seed `stake:75` at 3793 is a red herring — the diorama is allowed to be $75; the schema default is the leak.

Net: the crash is a one-line implementation bug; the reason it was catastrophic rather than cosmetic is a mechanics gap (lock is four client writes with no server transaction, no idempotency, no phase invariant) and an IA decision (link-only invites) whose secondary surfaces were never built. This is not a user-education problem — the organizer read the copy correctly and the product lied to them.

verdicts.reasoning:
The core finding reproduces live and contradicts the product's own stated intent; it is not intentional complexity and no in-app help would rescue a member from it. Two sub-claims do not survive as stated.

CORE (survives, reproduced): Signed in as the joiner persona (a PLAYER in The Papago Grind), Home's hero is "THE PAPAGO GRIND · forming · 7 days to first tee · 5 golfers in · [Lock it in and invite your crew]" and the button opens the create-league wizard at step 2 with a live "Lock the bylaws & form the squads" button. The code confirms why: renderHomeHero's block 4 (index.html ~10074-10115) fires for ANY league not in 'season' — i.e. both 'setup' AND 'draft' — and builds nextStep from league name + member count only, with no CS.member.role check, routing toWiz(2). D40 (decision-log line 1139, 2026-07-20) states the principle verbatim: "a member must never see the Pro's configuration tool", and its built backstop is only the enterLeague route (index.html 14497-14501). D96 (decision-log line 3422, 2026-08-04) added the hero CTA for the abandoned-solo-Pro recovery case; its Tradeoffs discuss only the Pro and never mention members. D40's premise that "members can only join a locked league" is also false in code: join_league (20260714040000_join_polish.sql:21-38) has no phase check, and the code chip is shown pre-lock (D40's own CONFLICT line defers those "passive code displays" as harmless because of the routing backstop — which Home's CTA bypasses). More importantly, the audit league was actually LOCKED (phase 'draft': room chip "Squad formation", League tab "LIVE NOW — CAPTAINS READY"), so this is the INTENDED post-lock, pre-draw window every invited member lives in — not a harness-only state. So: unintended gap created by D96 silently reopening what D40 closed, not a knowing design choice.

Wizard exposure is real: renderProChip (index.html ~13k) stamps whoever is signed in as "THE PRO" (shot 56-AI shows "Marcus @marcus · you run this league · THE PRO"); #wizCancel (15527-15538) asks a member "Cancel this league? … discards it completely" and calls delete_league; #lockBtn (15471) runs lockBylaws — four direct table writes plus form_squads, not one guarded RPC. The server held in every path (delete_league 20260712230000:23 and form_squads 20260711130000:21 raise 'commissioner only'; settings_write / seasons_write / leagues_update RLS are commissioner-only, baseline 2156/2305/2313), so nothing was ever at risk — but the client presented a member with a destructive confirm and a lock button, which is the D40 failure exactly.

Status contradiction is real and structural: five strings for one phase, each hard-coded per component from state.phase — hero 'forming' (10103), switcherChip 'Squad formation' (15513), #homeDraft "Squads are forming · The Pro has the list" (3414-3416), #hubDraftSub 'LIVE NOW — CAPTAINS READY' (12230-12232; captains vocabulary for a blind-draw league whose captains engine CLAUDE.md lists as unbuilt), and the board fallback "<league> is live — post the first round" (14710). No single league-state source.

No next step for members is real: the D82 orientation (2698-2720), the five You › How it works guides (2924-2930: places, games, posting, buddies, scoring) and the D3 join covenant (17296-17320) never explain the Pro role, what "lock" is, or that rounds before first tee do not count. Testers who read them (agent4, agent6) still could not answer "what do I do now".

REFUTED SUB-CLAIM — "the You tab renders that wizard" (M-031): this is a HARNESS ARTIFACT. bx.mjs:127 resolves a bare `click You` as page.getByText('You', {exact:false}) — case-insensitive substring, first visible match in DOM order. #homeHero (index.html 2822) precedes the phone's bottom <nav class="tabbar"> (3643) and the desktop sidebar navitems (2745-2754) are hidden at phone width, so on Home the first visible element containing "you" is BUTTON.hh-cta "Lock it in and invite YOUr crew". Reproduced: emulated match list on Home = [hh-cta, "Monthly floor … you're short", "Around your buddies", "Since you were here"]; `click You` → "Create your league · Review the bylaws, then lock it in"; `click role=button name=You` → the real You tab (Marcus @marcus). This also explains why the "hijack" always showed step 2 (the CTA's target), happened before anyone had touched the hero (agent1 15:22), and never happened from Clubhouse. switchView (4153-4200) has no path from data-v="stats" to the wizard. It is nonetheless a second symptom of the same root cause (the CTA's presence), so it strengthens the core rather than weakening it.

OVERSTATED SUB-CLAIM — "the draw tool is exposed" (M-032): renderFormation (14843-14866) gates the Draw squads / Start the season buttons on commissioner; members see the screen (developer copy "THE HAT SHUFFLES SERVER-SIDE", no back link, inert pool chips) but cannot act. Real, minor.

Would a user who read the help still hit it? Yes — the help never names roles or the lock. Did testers contradict themselves? No; four independent personas logged the same hero and the organizer persona independently logged the same five status strings.

The finding stands, with three refinements that change the fix.

1. CONFIRMED — the hero is role-blind. index.html:10071–10108 (`renderHomeHero`, branch 4 "forming") computes `nextStep` from `unnamed`/`solo` only; there is no `CS.member.role` check, so every member of a non-season league gets `{label:'Lock it in and invite your crew', go:toWiz(2,null)}`, which calls `renderWizard(); switchView('wizard')`. `switchView` (4153–4200) has no role gate on 'wizard' (4163 even REDIRECTS `draft`→`wizard` while in setup), so the wizard is reachable by any caller. D40's principle ("a member must never see the Pro's configuration tool") was implemented once, as the enterLeague backstop at 14494–14501, and D96 added a second entrance a month later without re-reading it. D96's own tradeoff line ("a league that is named and crewed but deliberately unlocked will be told to lock every time") shows it was reasoning only about the Pro.

2. NEW — the CTA is also PHASE-blind: the Papago Grind was already LOCKED. Members saw "SQUADS ARE FORMING · The Pro has the list" (3414–3416, rendered only when `p==='draft'`, renderPhase 12185) and "Squads · LIVE NOW — CAPTAINS READY" (12231, `p==='draft'`). Phase `draft` = bylaws locked, season row exists, squads undrawn. The hero's only phase test is `starter = state.phase==='season'` (10076), so it says "Lock it in" for setup AND draft alike — the Pro gets the same wrong CTA (agent5's 35-home-after-failed-lock: the server-side lock succeeded through `form_squads` and the phase flip, the client threw at `staged.length` 15218, and Home kept saying "Lock it in"). home-arc.md §2 row 4 lumps "phase setup/draft or pre-starter" into one "Countdown" hero with no role column; D96 put a verb on it without adding the draft branch.

3. NEW — "server-verify lock" has nothing to verify with. `lockBylaws` (15122–15219) is not an RPC: it does a direct `league_settings` update (RLS `settings_write`, baseline:2313, `is_commissioner AND locked_at IS NULL` → for a member this filters to ZERO rows with NO error), then a `seasons` select/insert (RLS 2305), then `form_squads` (the only step that raises 'commissioner only', 20260711130000:21). A member's lock is refused by accident of a later step; the same accident is why the harness log shows only the Cancel refusal. This violates CLAUDE.md's "writes with game consequences go through security-definer RPCs" and is the same landmine family as the four silent direct writes found 2026-08-28.

4. PARTIAL REFUTATION — "the You tab renders the wizard" (M-031) is a harness artifact, not an app route. bx.mjs `click` resolves `page.getByText(target,{exact:false}).filter({visible:true}).first()`, falling back to `getByRole('button',{name,exact:false})` — case-insensitive SUBSTRING matching. On Home the first visible element whose text contains "you" is the hero CTA "Lock it in and invite YOUr crew" (#homeHero inside #view-home at 2822), which precedes the mobile tabbar "You" (3643) in DOM order; the desktop sidebar "You" (2754) is `display:none` below 960px (CSS 125). From Clubhouse and from the wizard's review step no earlier button contains "you", so the tabbar wins → profile. That reproduces all three observations exactly (Home→wizard 3/3; Clubhouse→profile; wizard→profile) and no code path in switchView/4202 can yield 'wizard' from 'stats'. It does not weaken the finding — the artifact exists only because a player's Home carries a "your crew" CTA — but the fix is NOT a route change. Verify with `click css=.tabbar [data-v="stats"]` from Home.

5. Members inside an UNLOCKED league are reachable too: `join_league` (20260714040000) has no phase check and `invite_golfer` (20260827210000:8) gates only the inviter; the room's "Add golfers" is documented to "always work" on an unlocked league (3373–3376). D40 assumed pre-lock joins were unreachable; the enterLeague backstop is therefore load-bearing and the hero walks around it.

6. Status strings are hard-coded per component, each with its own vocabulary: hero eyebrow 'forming' for setup+draft (10103); switcher chips 'Setup — invites open' / 'Squad formation' (15514–15516); hhPhase (12873–12879); phaseSub 'Squad formation · rosters pending' (12203–12212); hubDraftSub 'OPENS AFTER SETTINGS LOCK' / 'LIVE NOW — CAPTAINS READY' / 'Complete · rosters locked' (3553 default, 12229–12232); homeDraft 'Squads are forming · The Pro has the list' (3415–3416); kickoff 'SQUADS LOCKED' (3428/12225); and a client-fabricated board line "<league> is live — post the first round" when the feed is empty (14710). "Captains" is vocabulary from the retired snake-draft engine (spec §15: captains are an optional label until the Final needs them).

7. Cancel (15529–15541) is wired for every viewer, uses `window.confirm`, and calls `delete_league`; the server refuses ('commissioner only'). A human on a phone gets a native dialog offering to discard a friend's league.

8. The phone already has the missing model: HomeView.swift:566–568 splits the forming line by `m.isPro` and has no forming CTA — safe but passive (the member line "The bylaws lock at the tee." still names no action). WizardState.swift:440 still carries `ctaLock = "Lock it in and invite your crew"`.

Hierarchy level: an IA/mechanics gap — the client has no single "league stage × viewer role" model, so each surface derives its own label and verb from `state.phase` (or from nothing). D40's principle was never promoted from a routing backstop to a view-level rule, and the member's post-join "what now" was never designed (home-arc §2 has no role column). The vision's "App Should Feel Alive" question is answered for the Pro (D96) and left blank for the 4–11 people per league who are not the Pro.

verdicts.rootCause: IA/mechanics level: Cup Season has a league lifecycle (setup → draft → preseason → season → cup_final → complete) and two roles (Pro / member), but the client has no single derived "stage × role" state — every Home/Clubhouse surface hand-derives its own label and verb from `state.phase`, and the hero (the one place a member looks for "what now") derives its verb from name and member count only. D40's principle ("a member must never see the Pro's configuration tool") lived as one routing backstop in enterLeague, never as a rule on the wizard view; D96 then added a second door to the wizard from the hero, reasoning only about the Pro-in-setup case, and the home-arc spec row it implemented ("setup/draft or pre-starter → Countdown") has neither a role column nor a draft branch. Consequence: a member's Home leads with the Pro's setup verb ("Lock it in") for a league that is not theirs and is already locked, the wizard renders their friend's bylaws under "Create your league" with a live lock and a discard, and five surfaces narrate the same stage in five vocabularies. Two implementation faults make it worse than a copy bug: the lock is a direct table write (no `lock_league` RPC), so role enforcement is accidental (zero-row RLS update with no error, then `form_squads` happens to raise), and pre-lock membership is reachable via `join_league`/"Add golfers", so the backstop is load-bearing. The You-tab hijack is a harness substring-match artifact ("invite YOUr crew"), not a route bug — but it is a direct symptom of the same misplaced CTA.

verdicts.reasoning:
I tried to reduce this to first-timer unfamiliarity and could not. Unfamiliarity is when a user lacks a concept the product explains somewhere (what a differential is, what a band is) and it clears once they read the scoring sheet. What the testers hit is the product asserting opposite facts about the SAME round on adjacent screens, and every one of those contradictions is reproducible from code, not from the tester's inexperience:

1. The form's headline promise is false pre-season by construction. `recalc()` (index.html:6306–6341) computes `vs = state.myIndex − diff; pts = pointsFor(vs)` and writes "LEAGUE POINTS THIS ROUND 12" with no season-window check. The finish ceremony's own comment (6584–6591) admits "a pre-season or out-of-window backdated round scores 0 server-side, so the ceremony must NOT flash COUNTS THIS SEASON" — the team knew, fixed the ceremony, and left the preview lying. `v_rounds_ranked` (baseline 1347–1393) confirms: rounds only join a season when `played_on between starts_on and ends_on`.

2. Home and Clubhouse contradict each other in code. Home hero (10078, 10105): `const starter = state.phase==='season'` → "The season's on. Rounds count from today." Clubhouse (12222–12225) uses `atStarter()` (= before first tee) → "KICKS OFF IN 7 DAYS · PRACTICE ROUNDS HIT YOUR CARD, NOT THE SEASON." Screenshots nov/34 and nov/35, 30 seconds apart, show both. No amount of familiarity reconciles two screens that say opposite things.

3. Line 3198 "No league yet? The round still counts on your card" is static HTML, unconditional; five personas saw it while inside a league and read it as boilerplate.

4. The sign is genuinely inverted against golf convention and inconsistent within the app: 6339 renders `(vs>=0?'+':'')+vs.toFixed(1)` under "vs your index" (so -3.7 = worse, coloured red), the posted card uses `vsPhrase()` ("3.7 over your number"), the receipt (11519) goes back to signed ("-3.7 — POSTED ANYWAY"). CLAUDE.md's own rule says round cards speak named bands "never PvI/differential"; the preview and receipt violate it. Five of six interactive personas independently misread the sign on first contact.

5. The 95% allowance is not merely undocumented — the client and server disagree. Server pvi = `index_at_post × handicap_allowance/100 − differential` and `points = cup_points(pvi)` (baseline 1360–1364); the client preview, Home cards and receipt fallback all use 100%. The retention observer saw one real round as "Beat your number by 3.3" (client → 12-band) on Home and "+2.6 vs index · 9 PTS" (server, 95%) on the receipt. So for a Standard-preset league the preview can promise 12 for a round that scores 9 even IN season. Spec §16 (line 264) requires the receipt to show the allowance snapshot; the demo receipt (11912, "Index × allowance") does, the real `roundCardBody` (11495–11525) does not, and it prints "Your number that day 14.2" beside a 95%-derived pvi, so the receipt's arithmetic cannot be reproduced by hand — exactly what the competitive and organizer personas reported.

6. The casual persona's "+0.0 — PLAYED TO IT" after a "-9.8 vs your index" preview is a client/server split: the client still carries a blind 18 (`state.myIndex = Number(member.index_current) || 18`, 15110; the -9.8 = 18 − 27.8) while `score_round()` (20260716100000:81–89) falls back to the round's own differential. Preview said 5 pts/9.8 over; receipt said played-to-it (7-band).

7. Standings' "No rounds this season yet — post one and you're on the board" (11483) is technically accurate but is the first thing shown after posting; two testers concluded the post failed. Correct data, wrong sentence at the moment of need.

Convergence: all six interactive personas plus the observer hit it unprompted; rulesClear 3–5/10 across personas; the competitive tester (a 6.4 who reverse-engineered the differential formula) still ended "unable to verify a single point actually landing". That is not a learning curve that clears in minutes.

Two corrections to the finding's text: (a) delete DOES exist — on the You tab's ✕ (11353–11365, `delete_round` RPC with a native confirm) — just not on the receipt; (b) the receipt template has a conditional `Points` row (11520); it is empty pre-season because no ranked row exists, so the receipt is silent rather than wrong. Neither weakens the verdict.

The finding survives, and most of it is the product contradicting its OWN logged intent rather than testers misreading a deliberate design. Sub-claim by sub-claim:

1. PRE-SEASON PROMISE (confirmed, known intent not propagated). The owner's pilot already raised exactly this; commit 75682a1 (2026-07-24, "don't claim a pre-season round counts this season (pilot)") added a season-window predicate to the finish ceremony (index.html:6583-6591 → "COUNTS ON YOUR CARD", no points) and the board card says "PRE-SEASON · NOT COUNTING" (5370). But the fix stopped there: recalc() (6306-6341) still computes `vs = state.myIndex − diff; pts = pointsFor(vs)` with no window check under a static "League points this round" heading (3191) and a static "No league yet?" line (3198). The server (v_rounds_ranked, baseline :1372) only scores rounds with played_on between starts_on and ends_on, so the preview promises 12 and the season delivers 0.

2. HOME vs CLUBHOUSE CONTRADICTION (confirmed code bug). renderHomeHero branch 4 (10074-10105) runs when atStarter() is true and sets `starter = state.phase==='season'` — true for any locked league — so before first tee Home says "SEASON LIVE · The season's on. Rounds count from today." while renderPhase (12220-12226), under the same atStarter() condition, says "PRACTICE ROUNDS HIT YOUR CARD, NOT THE SEASON". Verified in ../screenshots/nov/34-reload-home.jpg. The variable conflates "locked" with "started".

3. "POST ONE AND YOU'RE ON THE BOARD" after posting (confirmed). openMemberHist (11480-11486) shows that empty state whenever the member has zero v_rounds_ranked rows, which is exactly the state of a golfer whose only round is pre-season.

4. THREE DESCRIPTIONS / SIGNED NUMBERS (confirmed; D1 half-implemented). D1 (2026-07-15) decided the display becomes "beat your number by 1.4" and PvI/signs never appear; vsPhrase() (5709-5714) exists and covers the ceremony, feed and share. But signed PvI still leaks at recalc (6339 "+5.0 VS YOUR INDEX"), roundCardBody (11519 "Against your number -3.7 — POSTED ANYWAY"), openMemberHist (11478 "-5.1 vs index"), the You/standings sgn() helpers (11440) and demo receipts (11830-11890). Spec §2.1 defines positive = beat; a golfer reads minus as under. Design intent that the implementation failed to convey.

5. TWO NUMBERS FOR ONE ROUND (M-047: 3.3 vs 2.6 — confirmed with root cause, and it is a real engine inconsistency, not copy). home_feed (20260723090000_home_feed_photo.sql:51) computes pvi as `index_at_post − differential` (100% allowance) while v_rounds_ranked (baseline :1360) and therefore round_card, standings and the member sheet use `index_at_post × handicap_allowance/100 − differential` (95% under Standard). For a ~14 index the 0.7 gap straddles the 12/9 boundary. Spec §2.1: "PvI is the universal currency" — it currently has two values. The client lifetime stats (16641, 16684) are also 100%.

6. ALLOWANCE INVISIBLE (confirmed against the product's own spec). D48 retired the allowance DIAL, not the disclosure: §16 says "Round receipts show the rating/slope/allowance snapshot" and D2 makes allowance "visible only inside receipts". Bylaws still print "HANDICAP ALLOWANCE 95%" (12090), round_card returns `playing_index` (round_card.sql:102), yet roundCardBody (11515-11519) prints the raw index as "Your number that day" and then the 95%-applied pvi — so in-season the receipt's own arithmetic does not reproduce its verdict. The demo receipt (showRound, 11912) has the "Index × allowance" row the real receipt lacks; the preview ignores allowance too.

7. "+0.0 — PLAYED TO IT" circularity (M-048, confirmed root cause): score_round (20260716100000_handicap_engine.sql:83-89) falls back to `index_at_post := coalesce(index_at_post, differential)` when the golfer has no index, so every index-less round scores pvi 0.0 / 7 pts "played to it". D49 assumed a starter index exists and asked for a "provisional" badge; nothing on the receipt says "no number yet".

Sub-claims that are intentional or overstated (trim, do not drop the finding):
- "beat by 3 never says 3 of what" is a deliberate D1/D2 simplification (differential/PvI hidden except in receipts, where the unit IS shown); the band-edge wording ("by 1–3" vs "3+") is a copy nit against §2.2's half-open ranges — the code (pointsFor 5693, bandName 5702) uses clean thresholds.
- "the receipt has no points line": roundCardBody shows Points and "This month · COUNTING #n" whenever round_card's v_rank exists; the testers' screenshots are pre-season where points is null. The real defect is a SILENT null state, not a missing line.
- "no edit/delete": no edit is intentional (§16 rounds immutable, D50 "settled events never change after the fact", CLAUDE.md); delete exists (delete_round via You › recent rounds ×, 11353-11365). Missing delete on the receipt and the missing immutability sentence D50 asked for (copy-only, "future UX pass") are discoverability gaps.
- "two believed the post had failed" overstates the logs: the skeptic wrote "a real member would think the post failed" (hypothetical) and the novice "I earned either 5 points or nothing, and the app will not tell me which". Testers knew it posted; they could not tell whether it counted. Four independent persona logs (nov, skep, comp, obs) agree and the code confirms each mechanism, so the evidence is not thin.

In-app help does not rescue it: "How scoring works" (17274-17297; reached from the You checklist 2930, the index editor 13758 and the join covenant 17303) never mentions the season window, the allowance, or the sign convention. A user who read every sheet would still watch the form promise 12, Home say "Rounds count from today", and standings show 0.

verdicts.reasoning:
The finding holds and is slightly understated: the contradiction is not one copy slip but three independent scoring "engines" plus two definitions of "season", each surfacing on a different screen of the same first-round loop.

1. The real engine is one place: `v_rounds_ranked` (initial_baseline.sql:1347-1380). It joins `seasons` on `played_on BETWEEN starts_on AND ends_on` and scores `pvi = round(index_at_post * handicap_allowance/100 - differential, 1)` → `cup_points()`. A round 7 days before first tee produces NO row, so `points`/`month_rank` are null and standings stay 0. That is the mechanic; it is correct and matches spec §2.1 ("Playing Index = Index × allowance"; PvI = Playing Index − Differential).

2. The post-form preview is a second engine (index.html:6306-6346 `recalc`): `vs = state.myIndex - diff; [pts,msg] = pointsFor(vs)` — no season window, no league lens, no allowance, and `state.myIndex` is the client's number (a starter/estimate; falls back to the demo 12.4 at 3793 via `Number(index_current)||state.myIndex` at 14458). It renders the headline "LEAGUE POINTS THIS ROUND 12" (calc block 3190-3198) whether or not any league will score it, under a static, unconditional fine print "No league yet?" (3198) shown to league members. It also disagrees with the server at the band edge: web `pointsFor(-1.0)` = 7, server `cup_points(-1.0)` = 6 (iOS BoardTests.swift:17-19 documents this and sides with the server).

3. The feed / You / career stats are a third engine at 100%: `index_at_post - differential` client-side (11547, 11578; comment at 16641 "PvI at 100% allowance") and server-side in tour_card_form.sql:51,67, and `round_card` itself falls back to it (`coalesce(v_rank.pvi, index_at_post - differential)`, round_card.sql:134). verdicts.rootCause: Mechanics + IA level, expressed as UI copy. (a) An UNLOGGED MECHANIC: "a round only scores for a league if played inside that league's season window, at that league's allowance" lives only in the `v_rounds_ranked` join and a code comment — it has no spec §14 sentence and no decision-log entry (rule 5), so no canonical phrase exists for Home, Clubhouse, form, card and receipt to share. (b) NO SINGLE SEASON-STATE PRODUCER: `state.phase==='season'` (league locked) and "first tee has passed" (`atStarter()` / played-date-in-window) are conflated; Home reads the first, the Clubhouse and ceremony read the second, so "Rounds count from today" and "practice rounds hit your card" appear minutes apart. (c) THREE SCORING CALCULATORS instead of one lens: the server view (window + 95% allowance), the client preview `recalc` (no window, no league, 100%, and a band edge that disagrees with `cup_points` at −1.0), and the feed/You/career fallback (`index_at_post − differential`, 100%). The bylaws' 95% is applied only inside the view and never printed, so a 100% number and a 95% number describe the same round on adjacent screens and can straddle a band. (d) NAMING: "counts on your card" was chosen as the ink-muted "NOT the season" state, but "card" is overloaded (D47 named this) and the phrase reads as "counted"; the receipt expresses "not scored" as the ABSENCE of a Points row rather than a stated reason. (e) SIGNED-NUMBER LEAK: `vsPhrase()` exists but `sgn()`/`(x>=0?'+':'')` sites still print +/− with positive = beat, inverting golf's under/over convention. (f) The first-round provisional state (index_at_post = own differential → always "+0.0 played to it") has no badge despite D49. Each of these is small; together they make the product's first promise to a new member visibly not come true, with no sentence explaining why.

synthesis.summary: Retention/social/monetization/competitor synthesis of the 2026-08-29 blind audit (8 persona reports, screenshots, cross-checked against spec, decision log, Guide, index.html and the push/season-email functions). The retention curve peaks mid-season (rank + gap + floor bar + a rival's name are legible in 3 seconds) and collapses at both ends: Day 0 (nobody can say what a cup/season is from the door; the first thing a joiner is told is a $50 buy-in) and Season+30 (by D23/D27 policy there are no re-engagement nudges and the only off-app emails are sign-in codes, a buddy request, and one season-end email). The emotional loop has identity, progression and improvement present; rivalry/nemesis present only because both observer leagues have two players; anticipation is a deadline with no stated consequence; stakes, redemption and title defense are absent on every reachable screen. Almost every absent element has a built or decided answer in the decision log (D24 magic number, D52/D108 weekly clash, D66 ceremony, D67 career record, D68 email, D105 race view, D41 run-it-back) that no tester could observe — no completed season, forming leagues, chip suppressed by a nearest-deadline sort, or shipped the day before. Social objects (recap PNG, public round/settlement/season pages, guest recap) exist but none verifiably left the app; the invite link produced only a code toast for all seven interactive testers; the scorecard sheet has no share. Monetization: perceived value 4, recurring 5, lock-in 3, switching cost 3, renewal 3; mean wouldPay 3.75/10; the D101 $89/league-year model is behind a flag and the web still says "COMING AT LAUNCH". Testers reached the product's own category ("fantasy-league-style golf season") unaided but said the app "doesn't tell you any of that until you dig"; what it looks like it sells is league administration and a money ask, while the layer they rated highest (live settle-up, 8/10) is the one the spec treats as a side product.
keyFindings: Retention curve: Day 0 return ~5, Week 1 ~4 (six of seven testers were promised 'LEAGUE POINTS THIS ROUND 5' pre-season and received 0 with no explanation), mid-season ~6 (hero '1st · You lead by 22 points over Jade' + floor bar work), late/finale ~5, season+30 ~2 — the product is strongest exactly when a season is running and weakest before it starts and after it ends.

The Cup Final — the product's namesake ending — is visible on exactly one live surface, a collapsed bylaws row ('CUP FINAL · Final 4 weeks · scored fresh'); D4's season-long foreshadow exists in index.html but is suppressed by a 'nearest deadline wins' sort until the final week, and D105's race view (shipped 2026-08-28) only renders during cup_final.

The weekly clash (D52/D108), the season-end ceremony/takeover (D66), the season email (D68), the career record (D67) and run-it-back (D41) are all built and were seen by zero testers — no league in the audit had a clash row, a completed season, or a second season; D106 (pot owed vs. collected) is still PROPOSED and is exactly the '0/2 in' beside two checkmarks the observer could not parse.

Rivalry and nemesis are present only by accident of two-player leagues; in the 5-player Papago Grind no tester was given a rival, a gap, or a 'this round matters because' line — the competitive persona: 'the only rivalry in my league today is the pride stake I typed myself'.

Off-app touch is thin by deliberate policy (D23 no push nudges, D27 2–4x/week cadence): the only emails in code are sign-in codes, buddy requests, the season-end ceremony and cancellation — no invite email, no month-close or floor-warning email; the observer received nothing but codes in 60 days.

Social objects exist (D30 recap PNG, D57 public round/settlement/season pages, guest recap text) but none verifiably left the app: 'Share the card' gave only a hidden 'Card downloaded', 'Share the invite link' gave a 1.5-s code toast for all seven interactive testers, 'Share the season' failed with 'Please sign in again' on a clipboard error, and the best-looking object (match-play scorecard sheet) has no share control.

Monetization readiness: perceived value 4/10, recurring 5, social lock-in 3, switching cost 3, annual renewal 3; mean wouldPay 3.75; every tester met 'MEMBERSHIP · COMING AT LAUNCH · THE PILOT RIDES FREE' with no price or payer; the D101 $59/$89/$109 league-year model is behind pricing.visible=false on iOS and absent from web copy.

Skeptic's own $79/year justification ('runs the whole season so nobody is the spreadsheet guy… scores every round against your own number… tells you when you're about to miss your two rounds… shows who owes the pot… the place the trash talk lives') is a list of built mechanics, none visible to him on the day he joined; what he could see (chat, calendar, pot ledger, gross scores, a $50 ask, a Pro's lock button) is replaceable by group text + spreadsheet + Venmo.

What cannot be replaced (per testers): the rule set — best-4/month vs your own index, floor, squad race, Cup Final — applied automatically across any course, with receipts; 'That is the product. It is also the part the app hides.'

Category gap: the product sells season-long competition / rivalry / a recurring tradition (vision, spec §12 'fantasy sports where your foursome are the athletes', Guide), but screen-by-screen it presents league administration (Lock it in, Add golfers, codes, a Pro, Pro Shop) and a money ask ($50 buy-in first, $0 collected pot); the highest-rated layer (live side games, 8/10 twice) is the one the spec calls a side product.

Prerequisites before pushing monetization, in order: watch one real season end (ceremony/email/career fire), make the race visible all season (foreshadow sort, seed/magic-number line explained, clash chip on every live league), stop promising pre-season points, ship D106, make the invite a link, then show D101's price where the wizard sets the buy-in.

synthesis.summary: Synthesis of the eight blind persona reports along three axes: the gameplay loop as experienced (seven scored transitions plus the macro Join→Next-season loop), the information hierarchy of ~28 web screens and 11 iOS screens (3s/10s/30s/after, primary question, dominant/prominent/buried), and a competition-visibility matrix flagging every surface that foregrounds admin, scorekeeping or schedules over the race. Observation, interpretation and product intent (spec §, decision-log Dn, index.html line numbers) are kept separate throughout; each finding cites the raw report, the screenshot path, and exact UI copy. The loop's energy dies at Result→Season impact (6/6 posting testers were promised points, shown zero, and never told the season hadn't started), then at Compare→Anticipate (no stake line, no projection, the Cup Final exists only as a bylaws row — 8/8 could not explain how the Cup is won). Competition is immediately legible on exactly two surfaces (a mid-season Home hero for one league, and the live scorer) and invisible pre-season everywhere. Most findings are re-discoveries of D4, D24, D51, D52/D108, D81, D96 and D105 — several built server- or client-side and unseen in any audited league. Twelve ranked recommendations are mapped to the transitions they repair.
keyFindings: Loop breaks hardest at Result→Season impact: the composer previews 'LEAGUE POINTS THIS ROUND 5–12', the ceremony says only 'COUNTS ON YOUR CARD', standings show 0, and the standings row says 'post one and you're on the board' — 6/6 posting testers could not say whether their round counted; the client computes the season window (index.html:6584-6596) and uses it only to withhold the points line, never to explain (D2/§16 gap).

Sign convention reads backwards to golfers on five surfaces: '-1.7 VS YOUR INDEX' (form, calcVs index.html:6339), '1.7 over your number' (ceremony), '-1.7 — A LITTLE LOOSE' (receipt), 'Best vs index -3.7 · Career best' (You), 'AVG VS INDEX -4.0' red (standings). The app is faithful to spec §2.1 PvI; 6/7 web testers read minus as good. D1 chose the phrase form precisely to avoid this and it shipped only on the ceremony.

Every non-Pro member's Home leads with the organizer's 'Lock it in and invite your crew' (index.html:10101-10110 has no commissioner gate; D96) which opens the creation wizard with a live 'Lock the bylaws & form the squads'; Home→You also opened the wizard 3/3 for two testers. For the actual Pros the lock threw 'staged is not defined' — ORG never completed setup, NOV got six false 'Lock failed' toasts while the lock had succeeded and a later structure change was silently discarded.

The endgame is invisible: the only in-app statement of the Cup Final is the bylaws row 'Final 4 weeks · scored fresh' behind Clubhouse › League › ▶ LEAGUE RULES & PRO SHOP; 8/8 personas could not explain how the Cup is won; no countdown, no seed explanation, no tiebreak, no 'what winning pays you'. D4 (July) and D105 (Aug 28, PROPOSED) both name this; D24's captions ('LOCKED', 'EVERYONE ADVANCES — 2 CONTENDERS, 2 SEATS', 'PROJECTED UNDER A GENEROUS CEILING') render on empty tables.

Anticipation is manufactured only by penalty (floor bar '1 MORE · 2D', 'MONTH CLOSES in 2 days' — shown pre-season and on the league-less Home) and by user-typed objects (pride stakes, tee times). No stake line (D51 decided 2026-07-21, unbuilt), no forward projection (D81's 'points forward on quiet days' ships only for ties), no app-named rival (rivalries facet = live-match W–L only), and the weekly clash chip (D108, renderClash index.html:4613) was not visible in any audited league.

Competition visibility: immediately legible on a mid-season Home hero ('1st · You lead by 22 points over Jade', 0 taps) and on every hole of the live scorer; legible with scrolling on mid-season Standings (three tables for two players, race below the fold); invisible pre-season on every surface — five-member league all zeros, feed gross-only, tapping a rival's row yields '0 ROUNDS · 0 PTS · [Post a round]', squads 'FORMING' / 'LIVE NOW — CAPTAINS READY' / 'Empty' on three adjacent surfaces. iOS: gap line drawn under the leader's row; Home '2nd' names no leader; 9 of 11 screens show no competitive data.

Join breaks at consent: the ?join= landing promises 'Enter your email and you're in', the real flow is email → code → golfer card → orientation → '$50 / player · PRESET Standard · 2 rounds / mo · Cup Final · final 4 weeks · [Join — I'm in for $50]' with no roster, Pro, dates, scoring or payment path; 'Not now' drops the invite; no invitation email exists; the Pro never sees the covenant; the wizard's hidden default buy-in is $75 (spec §7) behind 'Customize'; the Guide's 'invite by email' does not exist in the client.

Rules are four taps deep and phrased as parameters; rulesClear scored 3–5 across all eight personas; ~60 undefined terms in the union of glossaries; 'attested' is defined only on the live scoring screen after tee-off while the wizard review prints 'VERIFICATION Attested' for a preset whose card said 'GHIN rounds'.

The strongest beats are the composer (course → tee → rating/slope autofill → live preview → receipt with the differential arithmetic) and the live side games (strokes-off-the-low-man line, live ledger, netted settlement) — sideGamesCompelling 8 for ORG and COMP, and every posting persona named a $5 game as the reason they'd play again — yet nothing in the season screens (Standings, Pot, League, wizard) points at them, and side-game money never reaches the Pot ledger.

Screens flagged for foregrounding admin/scorekeeping/schedule over competition: forming-member Home, Clubhouse header, pre-season Standings, pre-season feed, composer, ceremony, League tab, Pot, Form squads, You, Schedule (which exits the league room), and iOS Home/You/Buddies/Board. Recurring mechanical friction: the install banner sits exactly on the ⊕ FAB; rating/slope placeholders read as values and a blank rating yields '-79.0 vs your index' with Post enabled; 'Papago Golf Course' listed twice in 5 sessions; first live-stepper tap lands on par unannounced; [live-resume] embed error on every boot in 5 sessions; 502s during Post.

The docs/audit/blind-ux-2026-08-29/screenshots/ directory is empty; all cited PNGs live under the session scratchpad harness/shots/{org,nov,obs,join,cas,comp,skep,ios}/ and should be copied before the scratchpad is reaped.

synthesis.summary: Rules & mental-model synthesis of the 2026-08-29 blind UX audit (8 personas). Extracted 45 competition rules the testers met or needed, scored each on discover/understand/predict/explain/right-moment with a tester-evidence confidence 1-10, and flagged 44 of 45 below 8 (only "best 4 a month count / a better round bumps your worst" reached 8; twelve rules sit at 1-2). Every finding is tagged OBSERVATION / INTERPRETATION / INTENT / GAP with report + screenshot + exact UI copy, and the load-bearing behaviors were verified in code, not taken from the reports. Six headline rule failures: (H1) rounds before the first tee earn nothing for the league while the post form promises 5/6/12 points and the Home hero says "Rounds count from today" (recalc at index.html:6341 has no date check; hero at :10105 fires from lock; v_rounds_ranked date join at baseline.sql:1372) - all six posting testers hit it; (H2) the Standard preset's 95% allowance is applied server-side (baseline.sql:1360) and invisible on web - the observer's "Beat your number by 3.3" vs "+2.6 vs index · 9 PTS" for one round is exactly the allowance, and iOS admits "A preview at 100% of your number" while web says nothing; (H3) the endgame is one bylaw row ("Cup Final · final 4 weeks · scored fresh"), 7/8 could not explain it, the §14.3 tiebreak ladder appears nowhere, D4's foreshadow shipped as undefined vocabulary (LOCKED / seed / +10 / seats / generous ceiling); (H4) the "vs your index" sign is by design (+ = beat) but inverts golf intuition, D1's words-not-signs rule reached one of five surfaces, one round was described three ways in four minutes; (H5) the rules prose is excellent, four taps deep, unlinked from Home/Standings/wizard/post form, in three vocabularies (GHIN rounds / Attested / auto-attested; D13's "Vouch" has 0 occurrences vs 15 "attested"; wizard still says "Pro-approved bye" against D14); (H6) 8/8 understood the ledger model, 0/8 knew how/when/whom to pay, $75 default hidden behind Customize, membership unpriced. The mental model testers left with is spec §1 stages 1-3 (POST → SCORE → COUNT) rebuilt almost verbatim with stages 4-5 (RANK → CROWN) blank - truncated, not wrong - plus no sentence anywhere that says why today's round matters (D51 stake line unbuilt). Includes a MUST-before-joining / MUST-before-first-round / learn-during-play / nice-to-know prioritization, a noun-by-noun break table (league, season, round, cup, Cup Final, match/side game, event, standings, points, pot, squad, the Pro, bylaws/lock, buddies, board), and the explain-to-a-friend comparison with side-by-side divergent readings of the same copy.
keyFindings: Pre-first-tee rounds (R10, conf 1): six of six posting testers were promised 5/6/12 league points by the post form and received 0; only the Clubhouse kickoff card says 'PRACTICE ROUNDS HIT YOUR CARD, NOT THE SEASON' while the Home hero says 'The season's on. Rounds count from today.' from the moment of lock (index.html:10076/:10105); recalc() at :6341 has no date check; v_rounds_ranked joins on played_on between starts_on and ends_on (baseline.sql:1372).

95% handicap allowance (R6, conf 2): applied server-side (baseline.sql:1360), shown only as a bylaw row; the web preview and Home card score at 100% so the observer's single round reads 'Beat your number by 3.3' on Home and '+2.6 vs index · 9 PTS' on the receipt (13.6-10.3 vs 13.6x0.95-10.3, inferred); iOS discloses 'A preview at 100% of your number' (PostRoundScreen.swift:406), web does not; the only 'Index x allowance' receipt row is in the demo (index.html:11912).

Endgame (R24-R27, R29, conf 1-3): 'CUP FINAL · Final 4 weeks · scored fresh' behind a collapsed disclosure is the entire explanation; 'scored fresh' used 7x, defined 0x; seeds/+10 head start only in organizer (i); the §14.3 tiebreak ladder (months won > best month > fewest rounds > coin flip) appears nowhere; LOCKED / cup seed / EVERYONE ADVANCES / GENEROUS CEILING undefined; D4 foreshadow half-shipped, D105 still PROPOSED; 7/8 testers said they cannot explain how the winner is decided.

Sign convention (R3, conf 3): spec §2.1 makes + = beat your number; the client renders '-3.7' red for a bad round; every golfer tester read minus as good at least once (NOV: 'I beat my index by 3.7 - why only 5 points?'); D1's words-not-signs display reached only the posted card (vsPhrase :5710) while the form (:6339), receipt (:11519), standings (:11412), receipt list (:11481) and You tab (:2884) still show bare signed numbers; CAS saw one round as -9.8 / 9.8 over / +0.0 PLAYED TO IT.

Rules depth and vocabulary (H5): 'How scoring works' is Clubhouse > League tab > collapsed 'LEAGUE RULES & PRO SHOP' > link (ORG found it 18 min in, only because lock failed); not linked from Home, Standings, wizard or post form; verification is 'GHIN rounds' (preset card :3250) / 'Attested' (review) / 'auto-attested' (live) and D13's 'Vouch' has 0 occurrences in index.html vs 15 'attested'; wizard (i) :3318 still says 'Pro-approved bye' against D14's auto-bye; three label sets for the bottom band; three phrasings of the floor.

Money (R30-R34, conf 3-6): 8/8 explained 'the app keeps the ledger, money moves between friends'; 0/8 could say how, when or to whom to pay; buy-in defaults to $75 hidden behind Customize with 'Use these defaults' primary; squad 60% never resolved to a person before the ceremony ('$51 on a $50 pot'); side-game cash never reaches the pot ledger and 'Post a stake' is explicitly never money (NOV/COMP assumed otherwise); 'membership lands at launch' twice with no price.

Roles and consent (R37, R41, R42-R43, conf 1-3): every member tester was handed the Pro's tools - 'Lock it in and invite your crew' hero opens the create-league wizard with a live lock button because D96's forming CTA carries no role check (index.html:10098-10112), undoing D40; 'See the squads' opens the blind-draw tool; a live game posted an attested 103 to the casual golfer's card with no notification; the only correction control is an unlabeled x on the You tab with a browser confirm(); D50's dispute paragraph was never shipped.

No-index scoring (R7, conf 2): a golfer with no index and <3 rounds sees a circular receipt ('27.8 DIFFERENTIAL · YOUR NUMBER THAT DAY 27.8 · +0.0 - PLAYED TO IT'); D49's 'provisional' badge does not exist in index.html (0 hits).

Season state copy: one unlocked one-member league is described as 'forming', 'Squad formation', 'LIVE NOW - CAPTAINS READY' and 'is live' across four screens; iOS Home says 'WEEK 4 OF 14' while its Clubhouse says 'WK 4 / 13'; You tab hardcodes 'FIRST TEE SUN' (index.html:16863) for a Saturday first tee.

Mental model verdict: testers rebuilt spec §1's POST > SCORE > COUNT almost verbatim (best-4 counting is the one rule at conf 8); RANK > CROWN is blank in all eight explanations; the lens model ('counts on your card' = profile fact read by leagues) never landed and 'card' carries five meanings; no surface says why a particular round matters (D51 unbuilt); every persona wrote some form of 'the organizer will have to explain the rules, because the app doesn't' - failing the vision's own 'never need a tutorial' metric.

Prioritization: MUST before joining - buy-in and payment path, roster/Pro/dates, that squads exist, floor + penalty + bye, one-sentence scoring, one-sentence endgame, role boundary; MUST before first round - pre-season rounds don't score, bands, sign in words, differential at 95%, best 4, card-vs-league, eligibility, correction path, attestation and third-party posting; tiebreak ladder and ceremony become MUST at ends_on-27.

synthesis.summary: Terminology audit of the 2026-08-29 blind UX pass: a 97-row glossary of every product-specific term the eight testers met (grouped into container, roles, setup, scoring, endgame, money, playing, identity, events), each with what testers thought (quoted, disagreements noted), the actual meaning cited to spec/decision-log/index.html/SQL, a class (invented · golf-borrowed-different · fantasy-sports · leagues · ambiguous · overloaded · internal), a "normal golfer would ask" flag, and a plain-English alternative. Headline: the app introduces ~120 terms and defines almost none where first met (rulesClear avg 4.0/10); four nouns are overloaded with opposite senses (card ×5, cup ×4, stake money-vs-never-money, tee sheet calendar-vs-live-scorer, lock ×3 moments); eleven shipped strings directly contradict logged decisions (D1/D2 bare signed "vs index", D8/D48 the retired 95% allowance still shown, D12 "event/duel", D13 "attested" instead of "vouch", D14 "Pro-approved bye", D47 unqualified "card" and four code labels, D51 "counting cap", §15/D105 captain vestiges); and internal engineering language leaks on screen ("PROJECTED UNDER A GENEROUS CEILING" is D24's honesty rule verbatim, "the stepper", "the pilot", "staged", "bylaws §4" citing an unserved repo file). A verified math finding underpins the allowance confusion: the post preview and any unranked receipt compute vs-index at 100% (index.html:6315/11577; round_card fallback) while v_rounds_ranked scores at the preset's 95%, so the number shown is not the number that scores. Ends with a decision-log-contradiction table, a list of never-defined terms, a ranked top-10, and a three-step remediation (copy sweep against existing decisions → define-at-first-contact pass → four noun decisions to log).
keyFindings: Top-10 comprehension damage, ranked: (1) Cup / Cup Final / 'scored fresh' / seed / LOCKED / advance — 8 of 8 testers could not say how a season is won; the product's name is undefined and the endgame is one bylaw row behind a collapsed disclosure (D4 named this 2026-07-15; D105 says the race surface still doesn't exist); (2) 'vs your index' as a bare signed number — 7 of 7 web testers read the sign backwards or saw one round get three verdicts (-9.8 / 9.8 over / +0.0), violating D1's 'beat your number by 1.4' rule; (3) 'card' in five senses, worst at 'COUNTS ON YOUR CARD' which every tester read as 'counted' when it meant 'not in the season' (index.html:6588 shows the app knows); (4) 'the Pro' + 'Pro Shop' — every persona paused, three read it as the club professional (D15 chose the collision); (5) 'Handicap allowance 95%' — shown on two screens, applied on none, preview/receipt at 100% vs league scoring at 95%, and D2/D8/D48 said never show it; (6) squad / sqd pts / CAPT. / four formation states; (7) verification set GHIN rounds / honor / attested / verified / rated tees — five labels, D13's 'vouch' on none, 'GHIN rounds' describes a requirement that doesn't exist; (8) floor / short months / month closes / Pro-approved bye (contradicts D14) / counting cap (contradicts D51); (9) money nouns — 'stake' means never-money on the Pot tab and money in live games, side-game cash is not on 'the books'; (10) lock / locks at first tee / lock it in / forming / CAPTAINS READY — three lock moments, four phase labels, a false 'lock opens the invite link'.

Eleven shipped strings contradict logged decisions and can be fixed without debate: D1/D2 (bare signed PvI, 'Diff' on board rows, allowance in bylaws), D8/D48 ('95% hcp' on preset cards), D12 ('Start an event', 'vs-index duels'), D13 ('Attested' ×4 instead of 'Vouch'), D14 (wizard (i) 'Pro-approved bye'), D47 (unqualified 'card'; invite code / LEAGUE CODE / Invite code: / Code · for one noun; 'pride, on the books' vs books=money), D51 ('COUNTING CAP' bylaw row), D40 (pre-lock code chip contradicts 'Lock opens the invite link'), §15/D105 ('CAPT. —' column and 'LIVE NOW — CAPTAINS READY' for a role that no longer exists), D24 ('PROJECTED UNDER A GENEROUS CEILING' printed verbatim at index.html:4479), and Cup-Season-Guide.md:106 claims an email-invite path that does not exist.

Verified math finding behind the allowance confusion: the post preview computes vs = state.myIndex − diff (100%, index.html:6315), the receipt falls back to index_at_post − differential when the round is not ranked in a league (index.html:11577; round_card coalesce), while v_rounds_ranked scores every league round at index_at_post × handicap_allowance/100 − differential (baseline:1359–1363, 95% for Standard). Only iOS admits it ('A preview at 100% of your number — your league's own math scores it on the books', PostRoundScreen.swift:406). Near band edges the preview can promise 9 and the league award 7.

Systemic pathologies documented with evidence: undefined-at-point-of-use (definitions exist in the scoring sheet, five How-it-works cards and wizard (i)s, all buried); overloaded nouns (card ×5, cup ×4, stake ×2 opposite, tee sheet ×2, lock ×3, squad ×3, books ×2); three label sets for one concept (point bands, verification tier, invite code); golf words used against their golf meaning (the Pro, negative vs-index, short game, receipts required, tee sheet, 'No. 2' marker colliding with 2nd place); internal language on screen (generous ceiling, the stepper, the pilot, staged, the hat shuffles server-side, bylaws §4, mints a trophy, Moments/reveals as push-kind names); and the iOS week count disagreeing with itself (WEEK 4 OF 14 vs WK 4 / 13; HomeView.swift:526 vs LeagueCopy.swift:165).

Forty-plus terms are never defined anywhere in the product, not even four taps deep: seed, scored fresh (as a mechanic), short month, HELD, LOCKED, contenders/seats, generous ceiling, the climb, sqd, CAPT., R, Δ WK, SEASON DATE, staged, the pool, seats open, 'The Pro has the list', the pilot, GHIN rounds, net best ball, Wolf (short card), Sunningdale Rules (no (i)), riding, bank a unit, SI, EST 18.0 IDX, the stepper, Moments/reveals, FORM dots, Cups & events, Marker here, No. 2, bylaws §4, Preset Standard outside the wizard, counter, vs-index duels, the clinch, mints, the quoted 'Major' note, 'you lead 1–0'.

Recommended remediation in cost order: (1) a one-day copy sweep against the decision-log-contradiction table (start with D1 sign phrasing, D47 card/code, D13 vouch, D14 bye, D51 best-four, D48 delete the 95%); (2) a define-at-first-contact pass on the orientation screen and join covenant (cup, table, board, pot, squad, the Pro, first tee, Cup Final each get one sentence) plus linking the excellent scoring sheet from wizard step 2, the post form's band table and the standings header; (3) four noun decisions to log per working rule 1 — cup (title vs points vs final vs count), stake (money vs pride → 'forfeits', D64's own noun), tee sheet (calendar vs live), lock (publish vs freeze) — plus renaming 'the Pro' to 'Commissioner' and 'Pro Shop' to 'League pass' (D101's own noun).
